name: NGEx Minerals Ltd.
description: NGEx Minerals is a Lundin Group copper-gold explorer focused on the 100%-owned Lunahuasi high-grade copper-gold-silver project in San Juan Province, Argentina, and the Los Helados copper-gold project approximately nine kilometres northeast in Chile's Region III. The company is in the exploration stage, with recent drilling results establishing Lunahuasi as a globally significant high-grade copper system.
